youtube.description:
In this episode, Tanyi explains why AI can sometimes create false information in reports. Using the example of Wouri Express, a small delivery company in Douala, Cameroon, Tanyi shows how to prevent hallucinations by requiring citations and human checks. Learn practical steps to ensure your AI systems are reliable.

Chapters
0:00 Hook
0:22 Listening
0:42 Understand: where the story comes from
1:09 Decide: what we change
1:28 Build
2:01 Constraint and fix
2:34 User test
2:52 Where this applies
3:04 Ownership

Fictional teaching scenario. Wouri Express and its people are invented; the setting draws on documented conditions in Douala, Cameroon.
Complex AI. Explained visually. Built practically.

shorts.description: In Wouri Express, an AI report claimed a truck broke down. It didn't happen. Tanyi explains why this happens and how to fix it.
